text.text_excerpt: I've been eating from Chill Out Cafe for years now (found it when I attended Tulane). It is a cute, no-frills place with a nice outdoor patio and friendly staff. As a Thai food aficionado, I have tried many Thai restaurants in NOLA and keep returning here. Not that those others are bad, but this place is so consistent and affordable. Over the years I have expanded my tastes from just their Pad Thai (still my favorite in this city!) to their fresh spring rolls, green curry, drunken noodles, garlic chicken, and Himalayan chicken...all of which are great. I have also tried a few of their fried rices and love them all as well. Will definitely continue to be a customer!

Thai food is arguably my favorite genre of cuisine. So I like to think I am somewhat of an expert on the matter, at least about tom yum soup and red curry. The other day I was looking for cheaper Thai around the uptown area. I came across Chill Out Café and was a little scared after seeing their odd menu, but I was intrigued. Also the prices seemed reasonable. I called in for carry out and the women said it would be 15 minutes. I got there in about 12 and the food was ready, I love when this is the case. First I had my favorite food of all time, tom yum soup. It was very good! Perfect portion size, quality big chucks of chicken and a yummy tomato broth. I also ordered the lunch portion of...

Absolutely love this place! As a Thai Restaurant lover that lives in the area, this is my go-to restaurant! They have a lovely outdoor seating (limited) but lovely nonetheless. I tend to judge a Thai restaurant by their Pad Thai, and this place has a damn good one! I also enjoy their Fried Tofu and Chicken Satay as an appetizer! I also really like the "Thai Basil", you can add whatever protein you like. I personally like to add Shrimp. Overall, this is a place that I keep coming back to!
